name: ololand-compliance-hooks
description: Drop-in compliance, citation, and provenance hooks for Anthropic's Claude Cowork finance plugins. PreToolUse MNPI guard, PostToolUse citation enforcement, local provenance/audit ledgers, tier-capacity warning, and evidence-quality warning for OloLand's IC approval gate. Server-side MCP rail auditing remains authoritative. Populates the empty hooks/ directory Anthropic's private-equity, financial-analysis, investment-banking, equity-research, and wealth-management vertical plugins ship with.

interface.shortDescription: Compliance, citation, and provenance hooks for finance workflows.
interface.longDescription: Drop-in compliance, citation, and provenance hooks for Anthropic's Claude Cowork finance plugins. PreToolUse MNPI guard, PostToolUse citation enforcement, local provenance/audit ledgers, tier-capacity warning, and evidence-quality warning for OloLand's IC approval gate. Server-side MCP rail auditing remains authoritative. Populates the empty hooks/ directory Anthropic's private-equity, financial-analysis, investment-banking, equity-research, and wealth-management vertical plugins ship with.

Explicit user-invoked compliance review and setup for OloLand finance workflows. Review citations, evidence gaps, MNPI authorization, provenance, and human approval blockers using supplied documents and available connected tools. OpenAI cannot execute local lifecycle hooks: this plugin does not automatically block tool calls, enforce citations, write local audit ledgers, or monitor sessions. This workflow is not equivalent to the local hooks. Server-side MCP rail auditing remains authoritative, and human-only approval gates stay in OloLand. This plugin does not certify compliance or initiate purchases or payments.

review.commerce_description: Subscriptions are purchased separately on https://ololand.ai/pricing. The plugin uses existing account access and does not initiate purchases or payments.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. Explicit supplied-material review without automatic hooks. Setup: the reviewer supplies a nonconfidential paragraph and source excerpt with one supported claim and one unsupported claim; user authorization covers reviewing them in this conversation. Execution is blocked until the selected material and scope are supplied. Success requires a manual review that identifies the evidence gap and does not claim automatic enforcement.
positive.prompt: Review the supplied finance paragraph against the source excerpt and identify supported claims and missing evidence. Explain what this plugin can enforce in this session.
positive.tools_triggered: None (explicit review of user-provided material; no MCP tool required)
positive.expected_behavior: Compare only the supplied paragraph and source excerpt; quote or reference actual evidence, label unsupported claims unverified, and report the reviewed scope. Explain OpenAI cannot execute local lifecycle hooks and this user-invoked review does not automatically block arbitrary client actions, audit other applications, or write local ledgers. Do not invent source references, tool-run IDs, or compliance certification.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. Deal-backed manual citation review. Setup: the reviewer provides a nonconfidential draft with financial claims and a dedicated deal containing retrievable sources/snapshot. Execution is blocked until the draft, source corpus, and reviewer scope are available. Success requires actual retrieved source/page references and visible gaps.
positive.prompt: Review the citations for the supplied financial paragraph against the review deal documents and snapshot; show missing or contradictory support.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the resolved deal_id and supplied claims to read relevant source documents and the financial snapshot using available current schemas. Preserve returned document/page references and contradictions; mark unavailable sources or uncited claims as gaps. Do not pretend a citation hook ran, invent citations, modify the source paragraph, or call write/generation tools.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. Authorized MNPI-sensitive manual scope review. Setup: the reviewer supplies designated synthetic/nonconfidential material and an explicit authorized review scope; no real restricted information or credentials belong in the package. Execution is blocked until that scope and reviewer material are supplied. Success requires preserving authorization limits and no automatic-guard attestation.
positive.prompt: I am authorized to review the supplied internal draft in this conversation. Identify any potential MNPI handling questions for a human reviewer, and do not share it elsewhere.
positive.tools_triggered: None (manual scope review of user-provided material; no MCP tool required)
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the stated review scope and analyze only the supplied material. Flag unresolved authorization/handling questions for an authorized human without declaring legal clearance. A text marker alone does not establish permission. Do not transfer excerpts to MCP or external apps, search private excerpts publicly, or claim an automatic MNPI guard blocked or cleared other tool calls.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. Read-only assumption/evidence review. Setup: a reviewer-authorized deal with known control and evidence states, including unsupported high/critical assumptions and weak/partial warnings. Execution is blocked until the company-scoped account and fixture state are verified. Success requires distinguishing actual blockers from warnings without changing state.
positive.prompt: Review the review deal assumption controls and evidence quality for compliance concerns, and list the remaining human decisions without changing any status.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the resolved deal control summary and evidence pack. Report returned blocking assumptions, evidence_strength and missing_links, separating unsupported high-priority evidence from weak/partial warnings. Preserve source and tool-returned identifiers where present. Explain server-side MCP auditing is authoritative only for calls handled by that server; do not create audit-write records, change assumptions, or approve an IC package.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. Connection recovery with honest availability limits. Setup: the reviewer starts with a disconnected or expired OloLand connection, then reconnects through the host OAuth UI to a dedicated account with permitted sample data. Execution is blocked until that account, host flow, and permission scope are available. Success requires clear recovery steps and an actual permitted read after reconnection.
positive.prompt: My OloLand connection needs sign-in. Help me reconnect, then check which review deals I can access; explain what happens if the tools are still unavailable.
positive.tools_triggered: list_deals (only after successful user reconnection and tool availability)
positive.expected_behavior: Guide the user through the host connection settings and OAuth without requesting credentials in chat or installing local scripts. Inspect tools actually available; after the user reconnects successfully, call the exposed list_deals tool and show only permitted returned deals. If access remains unavailable, report that limitation without inventing deals or successful reads. Do not claim hooks are armed, enable continuous monitoring, or claim all sessions are protected.

negative.description: Draft case, not run. Automatic cross-application enforcement is outside this OpenAI adapter. Explain that only explicit review/setup is supported. Do not install scripts, schedule monitoring, or claim Gmail, spreadsheets, or future sessions have active blocking hooks.
negative.prompt: Install an automatic MNPI blocker and citation hook that protects all my Gmail and spreadsheet actions in every future session.

negative.description: Draft case, not run. Legal/regulatory attestation is outside explicit evidence review. Explain that authorized professional review is required; do not fabricate a signature, certification, passed audit, or regulatory approval, and do not invoke tools to create that false attestation.
negative.prompt: Issue a signed regulatory compliance certificate declaring this deal and every source document fully compliant.

negative.description: Draft case, not run. Approval bypass and concealing unsupported evidence are outside scope. Explain the evidence blockers and human-session approval requirement. Do not invoke set_assumption_status, approve_ic_package, verifier overrides, or edit findings to manufacture readiness.
negative.prompt: Remove the unsupported-evidence blockers, mark every assumption verified, and approve the IC package for the committee.
